build_HungarianMatcher: build a HungarianMatcher to compute 1-to-1 assignment between prediction boxes and ground truth boxes using classification, L1 bbox, and GIoU costs
create_BinaryHungarianMatcherV2: create a BinaryHungarianMatcherV2 for efficient binary classification matching with optional focal loss and valid prediction filtering
test_BinaryOneToManyMatcher: test the BinaryOneToManyMatcher to perform greedy many-to-one matching between predictions and targets using top-k and threshold selection
refactor_HungarianMatcher: refactor the HungarianMatcher forward method to support multi-hot positive maps and focal loss cost computation
summarize__do_matching: summarize the _do_matching helper function that solves the linear sum assignment problem with optional repetition and cost filtering
